breakdown.description: Thin airfoil theory (linear small-angle model) is applied at a large angle of attack where stall/nonlinear effects dominate.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that thin airfoil theory is invalid at a 20-degree angle of attack. It resolved this by changing the angle to a small, valid angle (5 degrees) and explicitly noting that this theory is only valid for small angles before stall, which aligns with the ground truth's recommendation.
